scope: temporary named debug profile attaches only the unique root-owned real interpreter copy for this CI job

identity.normal_runner_uid_gid: captured from actual normal process and checked against actual sudo caller
identity.interpreter: /usr/bin/python3.12 whole byte copy; fixed provider correspondence and stdlib prefix readback
identity.allocation: /var/lib/hepta-ci-g1-<bounded-run>-<bounded-attempt>-<literal-job>; root0:0 mode0755 create-new; no other global interpreter attachment

profile.mode: temporary CI-only unconfined debugging profile with explicit userns permission

workflow_inverse.setup:
- name: Provision job-private CI namespace Python
        id: namespace_python_setup
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/verify_ci_namespace_python.py
          python3 tools/ci_namespace_python.py setup

no new crypto or Cargo consumption proof
